**Unreconciled work parked in a worktree.** `ccx vcs guidelines` is complete and green but lives on branch `guidelines-lane` at `/Users/yasyf/Code/cc-context/.claude/worktrees/agent-a1992b66f70db3e5a`, based on `main` @ `a222707`. It must be merged into the cc-context working copy once phase B's rename settles.

Contents: new `internal/cli/guidelines.go` (~560 lines) + `guidelines_test.go`, and exactly one line added to `internal/cli/vcs.go`'s `AddCommand` list — the only shared file it touches. Every identifier it adds is `guidelines*`-prefixed, and its `gh` fake uses `$GH_REPO_VIEW_JSON`, matching the env var phase A added to `writeShipFakes`, so the two merge cleanly.

Deviations accepted: a `CachePath` field added to the `guidelines` struct (the spec required printing the cache path but gave it no home); `issue-template` collapsed to one doc since GraphQL's `issueTemplates` carries no per-template path and inventing paths would be worse; `code-of-conduct` carries the CoC name as its body since there is none server-side; PR-template paths resolved by `os.Stat` over the six fixed GitHub locations because the payload carries a bare filename.

Subtle cache behaviour worth preserving: the envelope records `contributing_probed`, so an envelope written while CONTRIBUTING was on disk (and which therefore never probed the community-profile fallback) reads as a miss on a later run that needs it. Without that, a branch switch removing the local file would silently report `contributing` as missing.

**Tooling gotcha:** `golangci-lint` bleeds across worktrees via the shared `~/Library/Caches/golangci-lint` — a bare run from a worktree reports findings in the parent checkout's files. Use a lane-private `GOLANGCI_LINT_CACHE`.
